CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.has_athlete_access(p_athlete_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.athlete_access aa
    where aa.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
      and aa.user_id = auth.uid()
      and aa.status = 'active'
      and (
        aa.access_role <> 'parent_guardian'
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.guardian_consents gc
          where gc.athlete_id = p_athlete_id
            and gc.guardian_user_id = auth.uid()
            and gc.status = 'active'
            and gc.revoked_at is null
        )
      )
  );
$function$

functions.name: is_recruitment_coordinator
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_recruitment_coordinator()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.user_roles ur
    where ur.user_id = auth.uid()
      and ur.role = 'recruitment_coordinator'
      and ur.status = 'active'
  );
$function$
